build_dense_detector: build a DenseDetector instance with a backbone, head, pixel_mean, and pixel_std for dense object detection
run_dense_detector_forward: run the DenseDetector forward method with batched image inputs for training or inference
preprocess_image_dense_detector: preprocess a batch of images by normalizing with pixel_mean and pixel_std, then padding and batching into an ImageList
transpose_dense_predictions: transpose dense per-level predictions from (N, Ai x K, H, W) to (N, HxWxAi, K) for dense detection models
visualize_training_dense_detector: visualize ground truth bounding boxes and top predicted boxes side by side for a training batch
